CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

3. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.

   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow
